Live dashboard of the running pod

Usage:
  lobo status [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for status
      --json   print one snapshot as JSON (pod, release, agent status) and exit
      --once   print one snapshot and exit

Global Flags:
      --config string   config file (dotenv; the OS env is never read) (default "/home/u/.config/lobo/config.env")
